revision: three-party view label map, revision 2. This file holds the structure of the screen (columns, step columns, states, outcome headlines, countdown, keys, trace) and the screens' own words for the parts and the scenes: the line under a part, the line under the crossing, and the title, the line and the availability of each scene. No part label, party role, stand-in note or button is here: those are in three-party/labels.json, the contract's label map. A listener that serves the screens adds the words of this file to that map in its answer to GET /api/labels, and the page takes parts, parties, timestamp and scenes from that answer.
